{{Top|leg}}
The '''Concert Shell''', located in the [[Alaphoe Gardens]] on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], was the location where numerous open-air concerts were performed for the [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] that attended the Gardens. Many guests sat on blankets on the well maintained lawns while others relaxed in comfortable folding chairs. During concerts tables with refreshments were available.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
